core.title: 9-3/4 Inch Swirled Slide Bolt, Acorn RL6BP

text.description_html:
Acorn RL6BP, 9-3/4" Iron Swirled Slide Bolt

The swirled end of this Acorn made slide bolt is reminiscent of the curling tendrils of vines, adding a slightly natural element to something that might otherwise appear to be static. This decorative swirled slide bolt is great for anywhere you would like to add a bit of rustic charm; the rough black iron finish mimics the texture of naturally weathered iron and carries a lifetime no rust warranty making it perfect for interior as well as exterior use. Comes packaged with surface, rim, and mortise strikes so it will easily fit almost any application. Slide bolts are great for securing light weight doors like gates, screen doors, or even for added security on back doors.

Also Available Matching:
4-1/2 Inch Swirled Slide Bolt
5-1/4 Inch Swirled Slide Bolt
7 Inch Swirled Slide Bolt

Features and Specifications of the RL6BP 9-3/4" Swirled Slide Bolt:

  • Material: Iron
  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Bolt Length: 9-3/4"
  • Back Plate Length: 3-1/4"
  • Back Plate Width: 1-1/2"
  • Comes packaged with three strikes: surface, rim, and mortise.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold Individually
